name: Exage 500LX platform pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 518 g for the complete left/right PD-M450 MTB platform pedal pair with two-screw toe-clip mounts. Toe-clip and reflector inclusion is not specified.

technical_document.title: Shimano 1992 dealer product manual, PDF page 33 / printed 30: Exage 500LX exact inventory: RD-M500-SGS 329 g and separate GS limits; FD-M500-B/FD-M500 band options; FC-M500-SG 170 mm 48/38/28T 756 g, separate BB-M550 339 g and PD-M450 518 g per pair
